description: The Needlebeak Dart is a small, swift avian creature known for its razor-sharp beak and darting flight patterns. It typically hunts in packs, swooping down on unsuspecting prey with incredible precision. Its sleek feathers shimmer with a metallic sheen, allowing it to blend into its surroundings. The Needlebeak Dart can be found in forests and mountain regions where it nests high in cliffsides.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The Needlebeak Dart has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the Dart's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The Needlebeak Dart has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Needle Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dive Attack
actions.description: If the Needlebeak Dart is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Needle Strike, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
